---
title: "Comparison genome quality"
output: html_document
---

Supplementary Table S1 uses the same QUAST/compleasm workflow as the focal assemblies.
Generate its input with `workflow/05-assembly-qc/qc-published-genomes.sh`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
quality <- read_tsv(here("data", "qc_published_genomes", "quality_published_genomes.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(quality) == 11, !anyDuplicated(quality$file))
table_s1 <- quality |>
  transmute(Assembly = file, `Size (Mb)` = `Total length` / 1e6,
    Contigs = `# contigs`, `N50 (Mb)` = N50 / 1e6, L50,
    `N90 (Mb)` = N90 / 1e6, L90, `GC (%)`,
    `Complete BUSCO (%)` = parse_number(S) + parse_number(D),
    `Single BUSCO (%)` = parse_number(S), `Duplicated BUSCO (%)` = parse_number(D))
write_tsv(table_s1, here("data", "qc_published_genomes", "table-s1.tsv"))
```

```{r table-s1, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(table_s1, digits = 2)
```
